groups: switching recording on writes the start of the period; no record exists from before the first start

the owner's reads become one row per hour, device and method with a count, first and last time and the widest period asked for; a refused read and a request that is not location information leave nothing
a share link is recorded by its id with nobody named; a company member, an administrator and an administrator signed in as the account are each recorded as themselves, never as the account
opening a live stream is recorded for the devices it was allowed to follow, and not for a device it was refused
no coordinate, device name, link token or e-mail address is in the table, and a row cannot be re-attributed, reduced, emptied or deleted

an administrator reads the ledger (and that reading is logged); the subject's file lists who received what and how without naming a member or an administrator, states the start of recording, and never claims a record from before it
each run of the recorder is a period: a clean stop writes what was gathered and closes the period, a kill leaves it marked as interrupted, and the time between periods is not covered
without a configured retention nothing is removed; a retention below six months removes nothing and says so; a configured retention removes only rows older than it
2,000 concurrent reads are all counted in one row with none dropped; a read takes 12.12 ms (95th percentile 14.33) with recording and 11.55 ms (13.01) without
